mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before an initial ADU consultation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before scheduling a professional consultation, gather a copy of your property survey, identify your property boundaries, and outline your target budget and primary intended use. It helps to decide whether the unit is meant for an aging parent needing accessible features, an adult child, or visiting guests. Note where your existing electrical panel, water main, and sewer or septic lines are located, as their placement directly impacts site planning. It is also beneficial to check whether your neighborhood has HOA restrictions regarding detached structures or visible exterior additions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare a property survey, note utility hookup locations, review any HOA rules, establish your intended budget, and define the specific living needs for the intended occupant.
